dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You really aren't bad at all...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Looks like Miss Jala really was discovered by the Knights of Favonius.

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you two! We meet again!

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: I... I told you about releasing animals before, right? ...Don't ever do it!

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: When I returned to Mondstadt to ask about the local specialties, two knights immediately arrested me at the gates!

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: I left the Knights of Favonius headquarters not long ago... I was given a huge fine and a lecture...

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: I had no idea the Anglers I released had no natural enemies in Cider Lake and were multiplying so quickly, almost to the point of destroying the lake's ecosystem!

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: Fortunately, the Knights of Mondstadt are capable and reliable. They handled it before it got out of control. Otherwise... Otherwise, I'd have become a villain, condemned by history for all time to come!

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: Though the Knights were all polite and nice, and they just patiently explained everything to me...

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: Mondstadters really are incredibly friendly. They didn't resent or shun me, even though I made such a big mess...

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: There was a little girl in red who saw me crying by the road, and she even comforted me with lots of snacks...

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: Though the fine itself was huge to me, it merely covered the losses incurred and the salaries of the knights sent to do damage control...

dialogues.speaker: Jala
dialogues.text: I just feel so bad about what I did! I really regret it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, as long as you can learn from your mistakes. The issue has been resolved, so you don't have to be so hard on yourself now!

choices.text: Just don't go randomly releasing creatures again!

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: Of course! I will remember this lesson! Always!

response.speaker: Jala
response.text: Perhaps... I should donate another shipment to Mondstadt... and then go apologize in person to those Mondstadters who were affected by my actions...

choices.text: And remember to tell your friends that.
